chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from his father, raising it (to the Prophet), he said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family): 'Whoever emancipates a believing [slave], God — Mighty and Majestic — will emancipate, for every limb of his (the slave), a limb of his (the emancipator) from the Fire.
And if she (the slave) was a female, God — Mighty and Majestic — will emancipate, for every two of her limbs, one of his limbs from the Fire, because the woman is [valued at] half of the man.'

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: Emancipated/freed (from slavery); also used for God's freeing from Hellfire
key_terms.النَّار: The Fire; Hell — eternal abode of punishment
key_terms.رَفَعَهُ: He raised it (marfu') — a hadith transmission term indicating the chain traces back to the Prophet
key_terms.عُضْو: Limb or organ of the body; used as the unit of divine recompense
key_terms.مُؤْمِن: A believer; here specifically a believing slave

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for freeing a believing slave in Islam?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches that manumitting a believing slave earns divine recompense in the form of liberation from Hellfire, limb for limb. This hadith reflects the Islamic institution of slavery as it existed in 7th-century Arabia, where manumission was actively encouraged as an act of piety. The ruling that freeing a female slave earns half the reward ratio compared to a male mirrors classical jurisprudential conventions regarding blood money (diya), where a woman's compensation was set at half that of a man's — a socioeconomic valuation embedded in the legal culture of that era.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Biin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Al Ballad, from his father, raising it,
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who emancipates a Believer, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Emancipate with every organ of his, an organ (of his) from the Fire.
So if it was a female, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Emancipate for every two organs of her, an organ of his from the Fire, because the woman is by half the man’.
